Remark
[affine maps]

Source: petersen:page-0243 ↗ def:pet-ch5-geodesic ↗ prop:pet-ch5-isometry-uniqueness 1. ch5:5.9.39A local diffeomorphism $F:(M,g_M) o (N,g_N)$ is affine if $F_*( abla ^M_XY)= abla ^N_{F_*X}F_*Y$ for all vector fields $X,Y$. (1) Show affine maps carry geodesics to geodesics; (2) show $F$ is determined by $F(p)$ and $DF|_p$; (3) give an affine $\mathbb R^n o \mathbb R^n$ that is not an isometry.
